The directly load-bearing items are the Narrative_DefaultRefTopicBranch (the process narrative this test instantiates), the Sample_DefaultRefTest record, the Observation capturing Tanya's verbatim quote, the Actor_Tanya_Staging profile, and the three style observations/metrics (StyleMetrics_DefaultRefTest, StyleObs_TechnicalJargon, StyleObs_DirectTone) that characterize the document's register. I also included Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform because it was surfaced in the focus section and provides product context for what Tanya is testing the system of. I expanded Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning's children (Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams) to check for overlap, but deliberately excluded them — they concern product vision and pricing from a separate 2026-03-10 document and do not bear on this system-mechanics test.
